faq.q: Is TTF to WOFF2 conversion lossless?
faq.a: Yes. Font tables are re-packed, not redrawn: glyph outlines, hinting, kerning and OpenType features are kept exactly. TrueType fonts stay TrueType and CFF fonts stay CFF.

faq.q: Are my fonts uploaded?
faq.a: No. Conversion happens on your device, which matters for licensed and unreleased fonts.

faq.q: Can I convert many fonts at once?
faq.a: Yes – select a whole family; you get a ZIP and CSS for each weight.

faq.q: Is converting a font legal?
faq.a: Converting a font you have the rights to is usually fine, but many commercial licences restrict web embedding. Check your EULA. Open-source fonts (OFL, Apache) can be converted freely.

faq.q: Which browsers support WOFF2?
faq.a: All browsers released since 2016 – Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 12+ and every mobile browser.

faq.q: Does it subset or change the font?
faq.a: No – the full character set is kept. Subsetting is planned as a separate tool.

guide.intro: TrueType (TTF) is the desktop font format with quadratic outlines, installable on Windows, macOS and Linux. WOFF2 is the modern web font container from Google’s Brotli-based compressor – typically 30% smaller than WOFF and 50–70% smaller than TTF. {brand} converts between them losslessly in your browser using the same open-source woff2 library Google Fonts uses, and writes the @font-face CSS for you.
uses: Self-host fonts on your website for faster loading and GDPR-friendly delivery.
Convert an entire family in one batch.
Prepare fonts for WordPress, Shopify or Webflow uploads.
Check exact file-size savings before deploying.
tips: Serve WOFF2 first and WOFF as a fallback only if you must support very old browsers.
Use font-display: swap to avoid invisible text while fonts load.
Preload the one or two fonts used above the fold.
Keep the original TTF/OTF as your master copy.
more: How the conversion works

A font is a set of tables (glyf or CFF outlines, cmap, kern, GSUB/GPOS and more). WOFF compresses each table with zlib; WOFF2 additionally transforms the glyph data and compresses the whole font with Brotli. {brand} decodes the container back to the raw tables and re-encodes them in the target format, so nothing about how the font looks or behaves changes.
Compared with online converters

Sites like CloudConvert, Convertio and Transfonter upload your font to a server and often limit free conversions per day. Here the font never leaves your device, conversion is instant and unlimited, and you get CSS too.

faq.q: Can I convert EOT or SVG fonts?
faq.a: Not yet – those formats are obsolete for the modern web.

faq.q: What about variable fonts?
faq.a: Variable fonts convert fine; all axes and named instances are preserved.
